name: Rallying Cry
description: Lets loose a rallying cry, granting all party or raid members within 40 yards 10% temporary and maximum health for 10 sec.\n\nHealth granted increased by 50% when not in a raid.

name: Avatar
description: Transform into a colossus, increasing all damage you deal by 20% and reducing damage you take from area of effect attacks by 5% for 20 sec.

name: Champion's Spear
description:
Throw a spear at the target location, chaining all enemies in the area to the spear's location and dealing 84 Physical damage instantly and an additional 128 Physical damage over 6 sec. 

While the spear is active, activating this ability will cause you to leap to the spear, dealing 16 Physical damage to all targets.

All damage dealt reduced beyond 5 targets.

Generates 10 Rage.

name: Disrupting Shout
description: Taunts all enemies within 14 yds to attack you for 6 sec, interrupts all spellcasting within 14 yds and prevents any spell in that school from being cast for 6 sec. Increases the threat you generate against the target by 800%.

name: Demolish
description:
Unleash a series of precise and powerful strikes against your target, dealing 802 damage to it, and 430 damage to enemies within 10 yds of it. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.

While channeling Demolish, you take 10% less damage and are immune to stuns, knockbacks, and forced movement effects.

You can block, parry, dodge, and use certain defensive abilities while channeling Demolish.

name: Demoralizing Shout
description: Demoralizes all enemies within 10 yards, reducing the damage they deal to you by 20% for 8 sec.

name: Shield Charge
description:
Charge to an enemy with your shield, granting you Shield Block and dealing 297 Physical damage to it and 94 Physical damage to all enemies within 10 yards.

Also stuns the primary target for 4 sec.

Generates 20 Rage.

name: Shockwave
description: Sends a wave of force in a frontal cone, causing 7 damage and stunning all enemies within 10 yards for 2 sec.

name: Storm Bolt
description: Hurls your weapon at an enemy, causing 9 Physical damage and stunning for 4 sec.

name: Impending Victory
description: Instantly attack the target, causing 20 damage and healing you for 30% of your maximum health.\n\nKilling an enemy that yields experience or honor resets the cooldown of Impending Victory and makes it cost no Rage.

name: Shield Wall
description: Reduces all damage you take by 40% for 8 sec.

name: Rend
description: Lash out with your weapon, striking all targets within 10 yds for 92 Physical damage instantly and wounding them for an additional 74 Bleed damage over 15 sec.

name: Thunder Clap
description: Blasts all enemies within 8 yards for 82 Physical damage and reduces their movement speed by 20% for 10 sec. Deals reduced damage beyond 5 targets.\n\nIf you know Rend, inflicts Rend on all targets.

name: Battle Stance
description: A balanced combat state that increases the critical strike chance of your abilities by 3% and reduces the duration of movement impairing effects by 10%. \n\nLasts until canceled.

name: Defensive Stance
description: A defensive combat state that reduces all damage you take by 15% and all damage you deal by 10%.\n\nLasts until canceled.

name: Heroic Leap
description: Leap through the air toward a target location, slamming down with destructive force to deal 8 Physical damage to all enemies within 8 yards.

name: Intervene
description: Run at high speed toward an ally, intercepting all melee and ranged attacks against them for 6 sec while they remain within 10 yds.

name: Ignore Pain
description: Fight through the pain, ignoring 50% of damage taken for 12 sec sec or until 451 damage has been prevented.

name: Spell Reflection
description: Raise your weapon, reflecting the first spell cast on you and reducing magic damage you take by 20% for 5 sec.

name: Last Stand
description: Activating Shield Wall increases your maximum health by 30% for 8 sec and instantly heals you for that amount.

name: Revenge
description: Swing in a wide arc, dealing 84 Physical damage to all enemies in front of you. Deals reduced damage beyond 5 targets.\n\nYour successful dodges and parries have a chance to make your next Revenge cost no Rage.

name: Shattering Throw
description: Hurl your weapon at the enemy,  removing any magical immunities and causing 214 Physical damage, ignoring armor. Deals up to 500% increased damage to absorb shields.

name: Intimidating Shout
description: Causes the targeted enemy to cower in fear while all enemies within 8 yards flee from you and their movement speed is reduced by 70% for 8 sec.\nDamage may cancel the effect.

name: Piercing Howl
description: Snares all enemies within 12 yards, reducing their movement speed by 70% for 8 sec.\n\nSpurs all allies within 6 yards, increasing their movement speed by 30% for 4 sec.

name: Ravager
description: Throws a whirling weapon at your target that chases nearby enemies, inflicting 250 Physical damage to all enemies over 10.7 sec. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.\n\nCleave and Whirlwind deal 50% increased damage while Ravager is active

name: Berserker Shout
description: Go berserk, removing and granting immunity to Fear, Sap, and Incapacitate effects for 6 sec.\n\nAlso remove fear effects from group members within 12 yds.

name: Wrecking Throw
description: Hurl your weapon at the enemy, causing 211 Physical damage, ignoring armor. Deals up to 500% increased damage to absorb shields.

name: Challenging Shout
description: Taunts all enemies within 10 yds to attack you for 6 sec, and increases the threat you generate against them by 800% for 6 sec.

name: Berserker Rage
description: Go berserk, removing and granting immunity to Fear, Sap, and some Incapacitate effects for 6 sec.

name: Warbreaker
description: Stomp the ground, causing a ring of corrupted spikes to erupt upwards, dealing 119 Shadow damage and applying the Colossus Smash effect to all nearby enemies.

name: Neltharion's Fury
description: Enter a defensive posture, critically blocking all attacks while a stream of shadowflame erupts from Scale of the Earth-Warder, dealing 40 Shadowflame over 3 sec to all enemies in front of you. You can use defensive abilities while this is active.

name: Odyn's Fury
description: Unleashes the fiery power Odyn bestowed the Warswords, dealing 182 Fire damage and an additional 29 Fire damage over 4 sec to all enemies within 14 yards.

name: Victory Rush
description: Strikes the target, causing 16 damage and healing you for 10% of your maximum health.\n\nOnly usable within 20 sec after you kill an enemy that yields experience or honor.

name: Pummel
description: Pummels the target, interrupting spellcasting and preventing any spell in that school from being cast for 5 sec.

name: Shield Slam
description: Slams the target with your shield, causing 80 Physical damage.\n\nGenerates 15 Rage.

name: Taunt
description: Taunts the target to attack you, and increases the threat you generate against them by 800% for 6 sec.

name: Execute
description: Attempts to finish off a foe, causing up to 170 Physical damage based on Rage spent. Only usable on enemies that have less than 20% health.

name: Heroic Throw
description: Throws your weapon at the enemy, causing 12 Physical damage. Generates high threat.

name: Charge
description: Charge to an enemy, dealing 7 Physical damage, rooting it for 1 sec.\n\nGenerates 20 Rage.

name: Shield Block
description: Raise your shield, blocking all melee attacks against you for 6 sec.

name: Attack
description: Starts combat by attacking a target with a melee weapon.

name: Battle Shout
description: Increases the attack power of all raid and party members within 100 yards by 5% for 1 hour.

name: Bladestorm
description: You become a whirling storm of destructive force, striking all nearby targets with your main hand weapon for 96 Physical damage.

name: Bladestorm Off-Hand
description: You become a whirling storm of destructive force, striking all nearby targets with your off-hand weapon for 5 Physical damage.

name: Bloodbath
description:
Assault the target in a bloodthirsty craze, dealing 181 Physical damage and restoring 3% of your health.

Bloodbath wounds the target to suffer 21 Bleed damage over 6 sec. Using Bloodbath on a target that is affected by Bloodbath extends the bleed by 6 sec.

Generates 8 Rage and has a 30% chance to Enrage you.

name: Bloodthirst Heal
description: Bloodthirst heals the Warrior for 3% of their health.

name: Devastate
description: A direct strike, dealing 44 Physical damage.

name: Hamstring
description: Maims the enemy for 5 Physical damage, reducing movement speed by 50% for 15 sec.

name: Raging Blow
description: A mighty blow with both weapons that deals a total of 77 Physical damage.\n\nGenerates 12 Rage.

name: Single-Button Assistant
description: Casts damaging abilities for use in combat, rotating through them based on priority.\n\nThe global cooldown of abilities used through the Single-Button Assistant is 25% longer.

name: Slam
description: Slams an opponent, causing 106 Physical damage.

name: Trauma
description: Slam, Whirlwind, and Execute now cause the target to bleed for 20% additional damage over 6 sec. Multiple uses accumulate increased damage.

name: Whirlwind
description: Unleashes a whirlwind of steel, striking all nearby targets for 74 Physical damage. Deals reduced damage beyond 5 targets.

name: Whirlwind Off-Hand
description: Unleashes a whirlwind of steel, striking all nearby enemies for 56 Physical damage. Deals reduced damage beyond 5 targets.

name: Disarm
description: Disarm the enemy's weapons and shield for 5 sec. Disarmed creatures deal significantly reduced damage.

name: Oppressor
description: You focus the assault on this target, increasing their damage taken by 3% for 6 sec. Each unique player that attacks the target increases the damage taken by an additional 3%, stacking up to 5 times.\n\nYour melee attacks refresh the duration of Focused Assault.

name: Bodyguard
description: Protect an ally, causing 40% of all Physical damage they take to be transfered to you. When the target takes Physical damage, your Shield Slam cooldown has a 30% chance to be reset. Bodyguard is cancelled if the target is further than 20 yards from you. Lasts 1 min.\n\nOnly one target can be Bodyguarded at a time.

name: Berserker Roar
description: Berserker Shout also reduces the duration of the next crowd control effect within 5 sec by 50% on group members within 12 yds.

name: Demolition
description: Reduces the cooldown of your Shattering Throw or Wrecking Throw by 50% and increases its damage to absorb shields by an additional 250%.

name: Dragon Charge
description: Run at high speed at a distance in front of you. All enemies in your path will take 24 Physical damage and be knocked back.

name: Morale Killer
description: Reduces the cooldown of Demoralizing Shout by 15 sec, and Demoralizing Shout now reduces the damage enemies deal to all targets, not just you.

name: Power Through Adversity
description: Second Wind reduces damage taken by 10% to 40%, with larger attacks being reduced by more.\n\nWhile Shield Wall is active, healing reductions do not apply to you.

name: Rebound
description: Spell Reflection reflects the next 2 incoming spells cast on you and reflected spells deal 100% extra damage to the attacker.\n\nSpell Reflection's cooldown is increased by 10 sec.

name: Safeguard
description: Intervene now has 2 charges and reduces the ally's damage taken by 20% for 5 sec.\n\nIntervene's cooldown is increased by 10 sec.

name: Shield Bash
description: When Shield Slam is used on targets that are casting, it reduces their damage done by 15% for 8 sec and the cooldown is instantly reset.

name: Storm of Destruction
description: Bladestorm, Ravager, and Demolish now snare all targets you hit by 60% for 6 sec and decrease their healing taken by 50% for 10 sec.

name: Thunderstruck
description: After casting Avatar, Shockwave, or Stormbolt, your next Thunder Clap roots all targets it damages for 4 sec.

name: Anger Management
description: Every 20 Rage you spend on attacks reduces the remaining cooldown on Avatar and Colossus Smash by 1 sec.

name: Armor Specialization
description: Armor increased by 6%.

name: Armored to the Teeth
description: Gain Strength equal to 5% of your Armor.

name: Arterial Bleed
description: Colossal Might increases the damage of your Rend and Deep Wounds by 3% per stack.

name: Avatar of the Storm
description:
Casting Avatar grants you 2 charges of Thunder Blast and resets the cooldown of Thunder Clap.

While Avatar is not active, Lightning Strikes have a 10% chance to grant you Avatar for 4 secs.

Thunder Blast
Your next Thunder Clap becomes a Thunder Blast that deals Stormstrike damage.

name: Barbaric Training
description: Slam, Whirlwind, and Cleave deal 10% more damage and 5% increased critical strike damage.

name: Battle-Scarred Veteran
description: When your health is brought below 30%, you take 80% less damage for 8 sec and healing you receive is increased by 100%.\n\nCannot occur more than once every 3 min.

name: Battlefield Commander
description:
Your Shout abilities have additional effects.

 Battle Shout:
Grants you an additional 3% attack power.

 Rallying Cry:
Grants an additional 2% health and duration increased by 3 sec.

 Piercing Howl:
Radius increased by 100%

 Berserker Shout:
Radius increased by 100%.

 Intimidating Shout:
Cooldown reduced by 15 sec.

name: Best Served Cold
description: Your dodges and parries make your Revenge cost no Rage 20% more frequently and increase the damage your free Revenges deal by 15%. Revenge increases the damage of your next Thunder Clap by 8%.

name: Bloodborne
description: Your Deep Wounds and Rend deal 25% increased damage.

name: Bloodsurge
description: Damage from Rend has a chance to generate 5 Rage.

name: Boneshaker
description: Shockwave's stun duration is increased by 1 sec and reduces the movement speed of affected enemies by 40% for 3 sec after the stun ends.

name: Booming Voice
description: Demoralizing Shout also generates 20 Rage and increases damage you deal to affected targets by 20%.

name: Bounding Stride
description: Reduces the cooldown of Heroic Leap by 15 sec and Heroic Leap also increases your movement speed by 70% for 3 sec.

name: Brace For Impact
description: Using Shield Slam increases the damage of Shield Slam by 10% and the block value of your shield by 5% for 16 sec. Stacking up to 3 times.

name: Brutal Vitality
description: 8% of damage you deal adds to your active Ignore Pain or the next Ignore Pain you activate.\n\nYour next Ignore Pain can be increased by up to 4,582.

name: Burst of Power
description: Lightning Strikes have a 15% chance to make your next 2 Bloodthirsts have no cooldown.

name: Capacitance
description: During Avatar, Thunder Blast extends Avatar's duration by 2.0 sec.

name: Celeritous Conclusion
description: Demolish's final strike grants 10% Haste for 10 sec and increases the critical strike chance of your next Mortal Strike by 100%.

name: Colossal Might
description: Colossal Might increases damage dealt by your next Demolish by 5%, stacking up to 5 times.\n\nMortal Strike grants a stack of Colossal Might and Cleave grants a stack of Colossal Might when it strikes 3 or more targets.

name: Conductivity
description: Lightning Strike damage increased by 10% and critical strike damage increased by 10%.

name: Crackling Thunder
description: Thunder Clap's radius is increased by 50% and it reduces affected target's movement speed by an additional 20%.

name: Crashing Thunder
description: Stormstrike or Nature damage your abilities deal is increased by 5%. Stormstrike damage ignores Armor.\n\nThunder Clap damage increased by 30%.

name: Cruel Strikes
description: Critical strike chance increased by 1% and critical strike damage of Execute increased by 5%.

name: Crushing Force
description: Mortal Strike deals an additional 5% damage and deals 5% increased critical strike damage.

name: Cut to the Bone
description: Mortal Strike critical strikes increase your Rend and Deep Wounds damage by 15% for 8 sec.

name: Decimator
description: Demolish's final strike applies Deep Wounds to all targets at 100% effectiveness.

name: Deep Wounds
description:
Execute inflicts Deep Wounds on the target.

 Deep Wounds
Causes the target to suffer 50 Bleed damage over 6 sec. If this effect is reapplied, any remaining damage will be added to the new Deep Wounds.

name: Defender's Aegis
description: Shield Wall gains 1 additional charge and its cooldown is reduced by 60 sec.

name: Devastating Focus
description: You focus on the target struck by your Devastator, dealing 30% additional Revenge damage to them.\n\nOnly one target can have your focus at a time.

name: Devastator
description: Your auto-attacks deal an additional 44 Physical damage and have a 25% chance to reset the remaining cooldown on Shield Slam.

name: Dominance of the Colossus
description: Colossal Might stacks up to 10 times. If you would gain a stack of Colossal Might and are at max stacks, the cooldown of Demolish is reduced by 5 sec.\n\nEnemies affected by Demolish take up to 10% more damage from you and deal up to 10% less damage to you for 10 sec based on the number of stacks of Colossal Might consumed by Demolish.

name: Double Time
description: Charge gains 1 additional charge and its cooldown is reduced by 3 sec.

name: Earthquaker
description: Shockwave also knocks enemies into the air and its cooldown is reduced by 5 sec.

name: Enduring Alacrity
description: Increases Stamina by 5% and your Haste by 2%.

name: Enduring Defenses
description: Shield Block lasts 1 sec longer.

name: Fast Footwork
description: Movement speed increased by 5%.

name: Fearless
description: Cooldown of Berserker Rage is reduced by 50% and Berseker Rage removes all movement speed-impairing effects.

name: Field Dressing
description: Healing received increased by 3% and all self-healing increased by an additional 10%.

name: Fight Through the Flames
description: Defensive Stance additionally reduces magic damage you take by 6%.

name: Flashing Skies
description: Thunder Blast calls down a Lightning Strike on an enemy it hits.

name: Focused Vigor
description: Increases Strength by 3% and your critical strike chance by 1%.

name: Frothing Berserker
description: Mortal Strike and Cleave have a 20% chance to immediately refund 10% of the Rage spent.

name: Fueled by Violence
description: You are healed for 85% of the Bleed damage dealt by Rend and Deep Wounds.

name: Gathering Clouds
description: Your attacks trigger Lightning Strikes 30% more often.

name: Ground Current
description: Lightning Strikes also deal 15 Nature damage to enemies near their target. Damage reduced beyond 5 targets.

name: Heavy Handed
description: Execute hits up to 2 additional targets for 70% damage.

name: Heavy Repercussions
description: Shield Slam generates 2 more Rage and extends the duration of Shield Block by 1.0 sec.

name: Honed Reflexes
description: Cooldown of Die By the Sword, Intervene, Interpose, Spell Reflection, Storm Bolt, and Pummel reduced by 10%.\n\nSuccessfully interrupting an enemy increases the damage you deal to them by 5% for 10 sec.

name: Hunker Down
description: Damage you take from area of effect attacks is reduced by 2%. Spell Reflection reduces magic damage taken by an additional 10%.

name: Impenetrable Wall
description: Shield Slam reduces the remaining cooldown of Shield Wall by 6 sec.

name: Indomitable
description: Your maximum health is increased by 10% and every 15 Rage you spend heals you for 1% of your maximum health.

name: Instigate
description: Devastate deals 20% increased damage and generates 2 Rage.\n\nDevastator deals 10% increased damage and generates 2 Rage.

name: Into the Fray
description: You gain 2% Haste for each enemy or ally within 10 yards, up to 8% Haste.

name: Javelineer
description:
Range of your thrown abilities is increased by 5 yards.

Damage dealt by Champion's Spear, Shattering Throw, and Wrecking Throw increased by 20%.

Shattering Throw and Wrecking Throw silence non-players for 3 sec.

name: Keep Your Feet on the Ground
description: Physical damage taken reduced by 2%.\n\nThunder Blast reduces damage you take by 8% for 5 sec.

name: Leeching Strikes
description: Leech increased by 3%.

name: Lightning Strikes
description: Damaging enemies with Thunder Clap, Raging Blow, or Execute has a 25% chance to also strike one with a lightning bolt, dealing 54 Nature damage.\n\nLightning Strikes occur 30% more often during Avatar.

name: Martial Expert
description: Critical strike damage of your abilities is increased by 10% and the amount of damage blocked by your critical blocks is increased by 20%.

name: Massacre
description: Execute is usable on targets below 35% health.

name: Mountain of Muscle and Scars
description: You deal 5% more damage and take 5% less damage.\n\nSize increased by 5%.

name: No Stranger to Pain
description: Damage prevented by each use of Ignore Pain is increased by 20%.

name: One Against Many
description: Shockwave, Cleave, and Whirlwind deal 5% more damage per target affected up to 5.

name: One-Handed Weapon Specialization
description: While wielding one-handed weapons your damage is increased by 3% and Leech increased by 2%.

name: Overwhelming Rage
description: Maximum Rage increased by 30.

name: Pain and Gain
description: When you take any damage, heal for 2.0% of your maximum health. \n\nThis can only occur once every 10 sec.

name: Phalanx
description: Thunder Clap causes your next Shield Slam to deal 10% additional damage and unleash a wave of force, dealing 69 Physical damage to all enemies in front of you.

name: Practiced Strikes
description: Mortal Strike and Slam damage increased by 25%.\n\nCleave and Whirlwind damage increased by 15%.

name: Precise Might
description: Mortal Strike critical strikes grant an additional stack of Colossal Might.

name: Punish
description: Shield Slam deals 15% increased damage and reduces enemies' damage against you by 3% for 9 sec. Multiple punishments may overlap.

name: Reinforced Plates
description: Stamina increased by 5% and Armor increased by 5%.

name: Resonant Voice
description: The effects of your shouts last 20% longer.

name: Rumbling Earth
description: Shockwave's range increased by 6 yards and when it strikes at least 3 targets its cooldown is reduced by 15 sec.

name: Second Wind
description: Restores 6% health every 1 sec when you have not taken damage for 5 sec.\n\nRestores 2% health every 1 sec while you are below 35% health. The amount restored increases the closer you are to death.

name: Shield Specialization
description: Increases Block chance by 8% and your Block value by 16%.

name: Snap Induction
description: Activating Recklessness grants a charge of Thunder Blast.

name: Spellbreaker
description: You have a 8% chance to disrupt magic damage dealt to you, reducing the damage it deals by 50%.

name: Stance Mastery
description:
Your stances have additional effects.

 Battle Stance
Increases the critical strike damage of your abilities by 3%.

 Defensive Stance
When an attack deals 20% or more of your maximum health in damage, that damage is reduced by 15%.

name: Steadfast as the Peaks
description: Stamina increased by 5%.\n\nVictory Rush increases your maximum health by 10% for 5 sec. When this health increase expires, you heal for any amount of the original Victory Rush that healed you in excess of your full health.

name: Storm Bolts
description: Storm Bolt also hits 2 additional nearby targets, stunning them for 2 sec, but its cooldown is increased by 10 sec.

name: Storm Shield
description: Intervening a target grants them a shield for 5 sec that absorbs magic damage equal to 3 times your Armor.

name: Storm Surge
description: Avatar increases the damage of Thunder Clap by 50% and reduces its cooldown by 50%.

name: Strategist
description: Devastate, Thunder Clap, Revenge, and Execute have a 25% chance to reset the remaining cooldown on Shield Slam.

name: Strength of the Mountain
description: Shield Slam damage increased by 15%.\n\nBloodthirst and Rampage damage increased by 25%.

name: Sudden Death
description: Your attacks have a chance to make your next Execute cost no Rage, be usable on any target regardless of their health, and deal damage as if you spent 40 Rage.

name: Thorim's Might
description: Lightning Strikes generate 3 Rage.\n\nRaging Blow and Execute damage increased by 25%.

name: Thunder Blast
description:
Shield Slam and Bloodthirst have a 35% chance to grant you Thunder Blast, stacking up to 2 charges.

Thunder Blast
Your next Thunder Clap becomes a Thunder Blast that deals 67 Stormstrike damage and generates 2 Rage.

name: Thunderlord
description: Increases the radius of Demoralizing Shout by 5 yards.\n\nEach enemy hit by Thunder Clap reduces the remaining cooldown on Demoralizing Shout by 1.5 sec, up to 4.5 sec.

name: Tide of Battle
description: Colossal Might increases the damage of your Overpower by 3% per stack.

name: Tough as Nails
description: Blocking an attack deals 42 Physical damage to the attacker. Critical blocks deal double damage.\n\nGenerates high threat.

name: Unyielding Stance
description: Defensive Stance reduces damage taken by an additional 4%.

name: Veteran Vitality
description: When your health is brought below 35%, you gain a Second Wind, healing you for 12% of your max health over 2 sec.\n\nThis effect cannot occur more than once every 60 sec.

name: Violent Outburst
description: Every 250 rage you spend triggers a Violent Outburst, causing your next Shield Slam to deal 200% increased damage, generate 50% more Rage and grant Ignore Pain.

name: War Machine
description: Your auto-attacks generate 10% more Rage.\n\nKilling an enemy instantly generates 5 Rage and increases your movement speed by 30% for 8 sec.

name: Whirling Blade
description: Your attacks have a chance to target a nearby enemy with Ravager for 4 sec.

name: Wild Strikes
description: Haste increased by 1% and your auto-attack critical strikes increase your auto-attack speed by 10% for 10 sec.
